1: # Treads 🌿
2: 
3: > *Step outside. Notice what lives.*
4: 
5: Treads is a mindful, local-first naturalist companion that turns outdoor walks into observational field journals. It combines pedestrian loop generation, on-device AI species identification, Wikipedia-verified naturalist notes, voice observation capture, tactile sensory cues, and one-tap Obsidian vault exports.
6: 
7: Built for the **Google AI Studio / Gemini Naturalist Challenge**.
8: 
9: ---
10: 
11: ## Key Highlights
12: 
13: - **🔒 100% Local-First & Privacy Sovereign (`CONS-01` - `CONS-04`):**
14:   - All field observations, GPS breadcrumbs, photos, and voice notes live directly in browser IndexedDB.
15:   - EXIF GPS metadata is stripped before client queries.
16:   - Strict first-visit privacy consent gate with durable storage request (`navigator.storage.persist()`).
17: 
18: - **🧭 Pedestrian Loop Navigation (`WALK-01` - `WALK-03`):**
19:   - Interactive MapLibre GL vector maps with outdoor topography tiles.
20:   - Suggested walking loops (15m, 30m, 45m) generated via OpenRouteService pedestrian routing.
21:   - Background-resilient GPS tracking with 35m accuracy filtering and automatic wake resumption.
22: 
23: - **🔍 Two-Tap Taxonomic Species Identification (`CAPT-01`, `EVAL-01`):**
24:   - Multimodal vision identification powered by Google Gemini.
25:   - Returns up to 3 candidate species with taxonomic ranks and confidence scoring.
26:   - Honest refusal engine refusing non-living inanimate objects and human portraits.
27:   - Headless 30-fixture evaluation suite (`pnpm test:eval`) verifying ≥70% organism accuracy and ≥90% honest refusal rate.
28: 
29: - **📖 Wikipedia Educational Fact Cards (`SPEC-01`):**
30:   - Three verified sentence-level natural history facts linked to source Wikipedia citations.
31:   - Cached for offline retrieval.
32: 
33: - **🖋️ Tegaki Handwriting & Cuelume Sensory Polish (`DSGN-03` - `DSGN-05`):**
34:   - Progressive Japanese Tegaki-style ink handwriting reveal with `Caveat` font and `prefers-reduced-motion` bypass.
35:   - Dual-oscillator synthesized Web Audio chimes (E5–G#5 major third capture chime, C5–E5–G5–C6 celebration arpeggio).
36:   - Tactile native haptic vibration (`navigator.vibrate`) on capture and hunt victory.
37: 
38: - **🎙️ Voice Observation Notes & Speech (`VOIC-01`, `VOIC-02`):**
39:   - Voice recording with live canvas waveform visualization.
40:   - ElevenLabs speech-to-text transcription and high-fidelity text-to-speech naturalist narration.
41: 
42: - **🎯 Daily Species Hunt Challenge (`HUNT-01`, `HUNT-02`):**
43:   - Daily rotation of naturalist targets (birds, trees, insects, fungi).
44:   - Celebration dialog and celebratory audio/haptic rewards on fulfillment.
45: 
46: - **📓 Obsidian-Compatible Vault Export (`EXP-01`, `EXP-02`):**
47:   - One-tap export generating a zip archive containing Markdown notes with YAML frontmatter, organized photos, and full database backup.
48: 
49: ---
50: 
51: ## Tech Stack
52: 
53: - **Framework:** Next.js 16.4 (App Router, Turbopack) & React 19
54: - **UI & Tokens:** Tailwind CSS v4, Base UI primitives, Lucide React, Tangerin Dream design tokens
55: - **Database:** Dexie 4.4 (IndexedDB) with `dexie-react-hooks`
56: - **Maps:** MapLibre GL 6.13
57: - **AI & Speech:** Google Gemini (`@ai-sdk/google`, `ai`), ElevenLabs API
58: - **Audio & Motion:** Web Audio API (Cuelume dual-oscillator synthesizer), Motion
59: 
60: ---
61: 
62: ## Getting Started
63: 
64: ### 1. Install Dependencies
65: ```bash
66: pnpm install
67: ```
68: 
69: ### 2. Environment Variables
70: Create a `.env.local` file with the following keys:

73: GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key

85: ```

---

# 🌿 Treads — Setup & Run Guide

Treads is a local-first naturalist companion built with **Next.js 16 (App Router)**, **React 19**, **Tailwind CSS v4**, **Dexie (IndexedDB)**, and **MapLibre GL**.

---

## 1. Prerequisites

Make sure the following tools are installed on your machine:
- **Node.js**: `v20.x` or `v22+` recommended
- **Package Manager**: **`pnpm`** (preferred)
- **Modern Web Browser**: Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari (supporting IndexedDB, Web Audio API, and Geolocation)

---

## 2. Clone & Install Dependencies

1. Navigate to the project root:
   ```bash
   cd /home/zeph/Code/treads
   ```
2. Install all dependencies using `pnpm`:
   ```bash
   pnpm install
   ```

---

## 3. Environment Configuration

Create a local environment configuration file:
```bash
touch .env.local
```

Add the following keys to your [`.env.local`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/.env.local):

```ini
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Google Gemini AI (Required for species identification & naturalist notes)
# Get a key at: https://aistudio.google.com/
# ==============================================================================
GOOGLE_GENERATIVE_AI_API_KEY=your_gemini_api_key

# Optional model overrides (Defaults to 'gemini-2.0-flash')
# IDENTIFY_MODEL_ID=gemini-2.0-flash
# FACTS_MODEL_ID=gemini-2.0-flash

# ==============================================================================
# 2. ElevenLabs (Required for voice notes transcription & speech narration)
# Get a key at: https://elevenlabs.io/
# ==============================================================================
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY=your_elevenlabs_api_key

# ==============================================================================
# 3. OpenRouteService (Required for pedestrian walking loop generation)
# Get a key at: https://openrouteservice.org/dev/#/signup
# ==============================================================================
ORS_API_KEY=your_openrouteservice_api_key

# ==============================================================================
# 4. Upstash Redis (Optional - for API rate limiting in production)
# Leave blank or omit in development (gracefully falls back if missing)
# ==============================================================================
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL=
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN=
```

> [!NOTE]
> In local development, the app can function with mock/fallback behavior if some API keys are not supplied immediately, but full AI identification, loop routing, and speech require their respective keys.

---

## 4. Running the Development Server

Start the local Next.js dev server with Turbopack:

```bash
pnpm dev
```

Open your browser and navigate to:
**[http://localhost:3000](http://localhost:3000)**

---

## 5. First-Time Walkthrough & Browser Permissions

When opening the app for the first time:
1. **Privacy Gate & Storage Consent**: Grant permission for local-first persistent storage (`navigator.storage.persist()`) when prompted.
2. **Location Permission**: Allow browser Geolocation access so MapLibre GL can plot your outdoor tracks and create pedestrian loops.
3. **Microphone Permission**: Allow microphone access when recording audio notes on observations.

---

## 6. Running Scripts & Test Suites

The project comes with test scripts and evaluation runners:

### Run the AI Headless Evaluation Benchmark
Validates the 30-fixture taxonomic identification accuracy (≥70%) and refusal detection (≥90%):
```bash
pnpm test:eval
```

### Export Engine Verification
Verify that the Obsidian vault zip exporter works with IndexedDB:
```bash
pnpm dlx tsx scripts/test-export-engine.ts
```

### Code Quality & Linting
```bash
pnpm lint
```
*(Or use `fallow` for dead code and dependency analysis).*

---

## 7. Production Build & Execution

To test a production-optimized build:

```bash
# 1. Build the Next.js production bundle
pnpm build

# 2. Start the production server
pnpm start
```

---

## 8. Key Project Architecture Reference

| Directory / File | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| [`app/`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/app) | Next.js App Router pages and `/api` endpoints (`identify`, `facts`, `route`, `speak`, `transcribe`, `eval`) |
| [`components/`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/components) | UI components (Tegaki handwriting animations, MapLibre map, capture dialog, recorder) |
| [`lib/db.ts`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/lib/db.ts) | Dexie IndexedDB models (`walks`, `observations`, `photos`, `breadcrumbs`) |
| [`lib/audio/cuelume.ts`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/lib/audio/cuelume.ts) | Web Audio API dual-oscillator synthesizer soundscapes and chimes |
| [`scripts/run-eval-suite.ts`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/scripts/run-eval-suite.ts) | Headless evaluation benchmark |
| [`FIELD-VERIFICATION.md`](file:///home/zeph/Code/treads/FIELD-VERIFICATION.md) | 8-step outdoor field testing and verification checklist |
